title: Explicit memory with supersession: `atrium remember` and the `atrium_remember` MCP tool
result: a statement is written to the registry as population `remember`, redacted, and indexed at once with its vector and the revision `ingest-synthesis` computes, so the next refresh finds it unchanged. `--supersedes RECORD_ID` marks synthesized episodes it replaces; the additive `supersessions` table is rebuilt from the registry on every `ingest-synthesis`; context ranks superseded evidence last and marks it `superseded_by`, and both hooks show `[superseded <date>]`. The fact-level update that Mem0 and Graphiti do, by explicit statement rather than an LLM merge.
